notes: Effects with authoredCurves=null are analytic formulas, verbatim from LayerAnimationVisualRuntime.kt.
width/height are the LAYER size in px. intensity = spec.intensity. vector = resolveAnimationVector(spec.direction).
Time bases: progress is eased AND ping-ponged when infinite; cycleProgress is raw 0..1; pingPong is the raised-cosine mirror, NOT eased.
A DEFAULT direction resolves to a ZERO vector; direction-aware reveals (RISE/SHIFT/PAN/SKATE) fall back to their own axis so they never go motionless.
BLOCK adds an overlayBar channel (a painted bar in the layer text colour); ASCEND is per-WORD glyph motion. Both need a renderer that honours those channels.
Layer payload: animations{entrance,exit,loop}. Legacy single animation still migrates (infinite->loop, one-shot->entrance). A LOOP slot MUST be infinite=true.
